beats.care: Travel between Tumakuru and Bengaluru for work or college? Plan a bus or another train on those dates.
beats.what: South Western Railway cancelled MEMUs 66571 and 66572 between KSR Bengaluru and Tumakuru on 12 days from October 23.
beats.why: Line and power blocks are needed in the Tumakuru station yard for its redevelopment work.

sources.title: Tumakuru Redevelopment: Bengaluru MEMUs Cancelled on 12 Days, Express Trains Delayed

tldr: The Tumakuru–KSR Bengaluru MEMU trains are cancelled on 12 days between October 23 and November 7 for station work at Tumakuru.
watch: Cancellations fall on October 23–25, October 28–November 1 and November 4–7.
